papers.title: Hierarchical Sparse Attention Done Right: Toward Infinite Context Modeling (HiLS-Attention)
papers.what: Learns chunk-wise sparse attention end-to-end from the language-modeling loss, matching full attention in-domain and extrapolating past 64x the training context length with 90% retrieval accuracy and sparse key-value access.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017); iTransformer

papers.title: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.what: Budgets on-policy distillation across agent turns with adaptive rollout depth and turn-normalized loss, raising accuracy for the same wall-clock budget on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Multi-Hop Search.

papers.title: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation (SenseNova-Vision)
papers.what: Casts every vision task as text-and-image generation in one multimodal model with no task-specific heads, matching specialized systems on detection, OCR, segmentation, depth, and camera pose.

papers.title: Light-Omni: Reflex over Reasoning in Agentic Video Understanding with Long-Term Memory
papers.what: Replaces iterative video-agent reasoning with a consolidated global state plus a latent action state built in one forward pass, giving 12.1x speedup and near-constant latency over M3-Agent.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026); Video Action Survey (Zhu 2020)
